name: Goodberry Jam
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot none; Price 350 gp/lb.; Weight varies

DESCRIPTION

Purple-green in color and delicious, goodberry jam is sealed into nice transparent glass jars. Nurturing druids created this treat in order to preserve the magic qualities of goodberries for extended periods of time. A jar of goodberry jam won’t spoil for more than an average human lifetime.

A spoonful of jam (eaten alone or on bread or biscuits) has the same effects of a goodberry spell. A jar contains typically 50 spoonfuls of jam. If all the 1-lb. jar is eaten at one time, the consumer is immune to normal and magical diseases for 1 week and doesn’t need eating or drinking for the same period, but is sickened for 1 hour after the hyper-nourishing feast.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 175 gp/lb.; Feats Brew Potion or Culinary Magic, Profession (cook or confectioner) 3 ranks; Spells goodberry
